_warning: Evaluation configuration. Deliberately NOT part of config.json. The runtime Config object cannot reach this file, so no inference component can address gold data even by an incorrect config lookup.

protocol.rationale: Paraphrased questions drawn from one conflict family test the same document pair and are not independent observations. With a small number of families, leave-one-family-out cross-validation uses every family as a held-out fold and is the correct technique at this scale; a three-way family split would leave too few families per partition to support any estimate.
